app.name: MPLADS Sentinel
app.tagline: Risk indicators for review of MPLADS works
app.framing: Risk indicators for review. Nothing here is a finding of fraud.

common.lowVolume: Fewer than 20 works: do not rank

states.offline: Cannot reach the Sentinel API. Is the backend running?

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access is scoped to your role: Ministry, State, District or MP.
login.demoNote: Demo password for every account: demo123
login.failed: Email or password is not correct.
login.pitch: Flags anomalies, fraud risk, delays and duplicate works across {{works}} MPLADS works, with the evidence attached for a human reviewer.
login.point2: Every action on a hash-chained audit trail
login.point3: Scoped to what each role may see

caveat.title: How to read this
caveat.proxy: The supervised model learns a hand-written proxy label, not verified fraud.

command.title: Command Centre
command.subtitle: What needs attention in {{scope}}
command.name: Name
command.moneyHint: Sanctioned value of High and Critical works
command.fundFlowHint: Entitlement is a scheme-rule estimate; the extract has no release figures.
command.bandsHint: Percentile bands: top 1% Critical, next 4% High, next 15% Medium
command.monthlyHint: March bars are highlighted: year-end sanctioning
command.vendors: Vendors by value in High and Critical works
command.vendorsHint: For review only. Vendors are identified by name alone.

map.title: Risk Map
map.subtitle: District view of implementation risk
map.unmatched: {{works}} works ({{share}}) are in districts that could not be placed on the map
map.hoverHint: Hover a district for figures; click to pin it.

alerts.title: Alerts Inbox
alerts.subtitle: Hypotheses for a human reviewer, highest priority first
alerts.keyboard: j / k to move · e or Enter to open · Esc to close · / to search
alerts.signalHint: Each channel scores 0 to 1; the risk score fuses them.
alerts.peerHint: Bars run from the 10th to the 90th percentile; the tick is the median.
alerts.verdictNote: Verdicts train the re-ranker; they are not published.
alerts.select: Select an alert to see its evidence

work.title: Work detail
work.snapshot: Snapshot from the eSAKSHI extract, not a payment ledger

dup.subtitle: Pairs of works that may record one asset twice, and groups that may split one project
dup.whyHint: Each component scores 0 to 1; the pair score is their weighted sum.
dup.decideHint: Recorded on the audit trail and fed back as a reviewer verdict.
dup.splitHint: A split group is a lead: several works of one type, from one agency, close in time, whose combined value is well above what one such work usually costs.

network.subtitle: Where vendors work, how concentrated districts are, and a first-digit check
network.legendSimilar: Near-identical names (not proof of one firm)
network.footer: sanctioned value is covered by the vendors in this graph.

delays.subtitle: Open works likely to run late
delays.lapseHint: Undisbursed value × delay probability; not a lapse ledger.
delays.queueHint: Open works ranked by the delay model's probability; badges show the strongest drivers.

compliance.subtitle: How often each rule fires per district, against the national rate
compliance.completenessTitle: Share of works with each field recorded

trends.subtitle: When money is sanctioned, on what, and at what unit cost
trends.marchShare: March months hold {{share}} of sanctioned value ({{months}} of {{of}} months)
trends.mixHint: Sanctioned value by work type; smaller types are grouped as Other.
trends.cost: Cost by state for one work type
trends.costLegend: Thin bar: 10th to 90th percentile. Thick bar: 25th to 75th. Saffron tick: median.

portfolio.subtitle: Implementation of works recommended in one constituency
portfolio.framing: Implementation risk of works recommended in this constituency. It describes how executing agencies are delivering the works, not a judgement of the Member.
portfolio.chooseBody: The list is alphabetical. It is not a ranking of Members.
portfolio.openDelay: Open works at high delay risk
portfolio.agenciesHint: Implementation is by district agencies; this is where delivery happens.
portfolio.attention: Works whose implementation needs a check
portfolio.attentionHint: High and Critical works, for review by the executing agency. Not a finding.
portfolio.noAttentionBody: Nothing in this constituency is in the top 5% of risk

models.subtitle: How well each detector works, measured honestly
models.proxyTitle: The supervised model learns a proxy
models.perDetectorHint: Synthetic anomalies were planted in a copy of the data; each detector is judged in its own review queue.
models.holdoutNote: Holdout: {{works}} works in {{constituencies}} whole constituencies removed before fitting; {{n}} labelled, {{rate}} ran late.
models.notFraud: Measures learnability of rules, not fraud detection
models.beforeAfter: Global top-5% recall, before and after step 2b
models.beforeAfterHint: One global ranking across all works. Kept for honesty; per-detector queues above are the fair measure.
models.fusionHint: Soft-OR fusion of six channels; bands are percentiles of the fused score.
models.floorHint: Works tripping a severe rule are lifted to at least High.
models.stateChannel: State-relative cost is shown as context only: it would lead on {{n}} works but lowered planted-cost recall, so it does not drive the score.

ingest.subtitle: Upload eSAKSHI rows, score them with the trained models, then commit
ingest.drop: Drop a CSV or XLSX here, or click to choose
ingest.formats: Same columns as the eSAKSHI extract · validated before scoring
ingest.hint: Validation and scoring change nothing. Commit inserts the works and raises alerts for High and Critical ones. The repository ships demo_data/live_demo_works.csv to try.
ingest.noRunsBody: Validated files appear here with their row counts.
ingest.resultsBody: Errors are listed by row and column; valid rows are scored in seconds.

clear.title: What would clear this
clear.hint: The evidence the score rests on, and the check that would resolve each piece.
clear.inQueue: Score {{score}} is above the review-queue cut-off of {{cutoff}}.
clear.notInQueue: Score {{score}} is below the review-queue cut-off of {{cutoff}}; this work is not in the queue.
clear.minimal: Resolving these would take it out of the queue:

cases.title: Investigation Cases
cases.subtitle: Group related alerts, record what was checked, and hand over a brief
cases.noneBody: Open one from a suggestion, or give a new case a title.
cases.suggestedHint: Split-work groups and districts with many open alerts. A suggestion is a starting point, not a finding.
cases.summaryHint: What is being checked and why. It appears in the PDF brief.
cases.framing: Cases organise review work. Referring a case asks an agency for records; it is not an accusation.

money.title: Money at Risk
money.subtitle: Sanctioned value of works in the High and Critical bands
money.byType: Money at risk by work type
money.treemapHint: Area is money at risk; colour is the share of that group's sanctioned value at risk.

sim.title: Threshold Simulator
sim.subtitle: Change fusion weights and band sizes, and see what the review queue would become
sim.weightsHint: Each channel's weight in the fusion. Nothing is saved; production scoring is unchanged.
sim.bandChart: Works per band, current against simulated
sim.verdictsHint: How works with verdicts would move. A good change keeps confirmed concerns in the queue and lets false positives out.

learn.title: Learning from Reviewers
learn.subtitle: How verdicts re-weight the detectors, measured on verdicts held back from learning
learn.seededSub: Real alerts matching a benign pattern
learn.precisionHint: Share of confirmed cases among the top of {{n}} held-back verdicts, ranked each way.
learn.channelsHint: Beta posterior of each channel's confirmed rate when active; prior centred on {{prior}}.
learn.legend: Blue band: 90% credible interval. Saffron tick: posterior mean. Thin tick: prior.
learn.rerankerWaiting: The re-ranker waits until the learn partition has enough verdicts.
learn.rerankerNote: Logistic regression on the six channels. Positive coefficients push a work up the queue.

citizen.title: MPLADS Citizen View
citizen.heading: Where MPLADS money went
citizen.pickBody: See what was sanctioned, spent and completed there, and what kinds of assets were built.
